name: Kourou ZLV (Vega launch complex)
best_known_for: Kourou's first launch site: Europa II, Ariane 1 and Giotto on this ground, rebuilt in 2001 for Vega and Vega-C
credit: The Vega launch complex (ELV, also called ZLV or SLV) stands on the site of Kourou's first launch base: built as BEC for the Europa II (one flight, 5 November 1971, failed), rebuilt as ELA-1 for Ariane 1 (first flight 24 December 1979), Ariane 2 and Ariane 3 (last flight 11 July 1989), and from November 2001 rebuilt again for Vega, keeping the Ariane 1 flame trench. Vega first flew from it on 13 February 2012 and Vega-C on 13 July 2022; Wikipedia counts 56 launches from the site by September 2026. Sources: Wikipedia (Ensemble de Lancement Vega launch tables), ESA (Vega and Vega-C pages); coordinates from Wikipedia and OpenStreetMap.
